summary: Implemented Console.set_window_title per the spec, uncommitted, with nothing run as instructed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and Control.title(title) passing one (type, title) tuple. rich/console.py adds set_window_title after show_cursor, checking only is_terminal and returning True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skips the assertion on legacy Windows), and a Windows-only test_control_set_window_title. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added section with a PR 2200 bullet. Tests and mypy have not been run, so they are unverified.
